about: Data for the sky globe's universe view (js/sky-globe.js). Coordinates are J2000 right ascension and declination in degrees.

stars.what: Stars to magnitude 6: [ra, dec, V magnitude, B-V colour index]
stars.from: XHIP: An Extended Hipparcos Compilation (Anderson & Francis 2012), VizieR V/137D, as packaged in d3-celestial 0.7.32 (data/stars.6.json, Olaf Frohn, BSD licence: assets/data/LICENSE-d3-celestial.txt)

milkyway.what: Milky Way outlines in five brightness steps, faintest first; every third outline point kept
milkyway.from: Milky Way Outline Catalog, Jose R. Vieira, as packaged in d3-celestial 0.7.32 (data/mw.json)

constellations.what: The 88 constellations (Serpens in two parts): name, rank (1 = major), label position and stick-figure lines
constellations.from: IAU constellation pages, with name positions and line adjustments by Olaf Frohn, as packaged in d3-celestial 0.7.32 (data/constellations.json, data/constellations.lines.json)

brightstars.what: Named stars brighter than magnitude 2: [name, constellation, ra, dec, V magnitude]
brightstars.from: Names from d3-celestial 0.7.32 data/starnames.json (FK5-SAO-HD-Common Name Cross Index, Smith 1996, VizieR IV/22, and others listed there); positions and magnitudes from XHIP as above

neutrinos.what: IceCube Gold and Bronze alert tracks 2011-2023: name, date, ra, dec (best fit), energy (most probable, TeV), signalness (probability of astrophysical origin), selection type, 90% error box [ra+, ra-, dec+, dec-]; events flagged CR_VETO (likely cosmic-ray showers) left out
neutrinos.from: IceCat-1: The IceCube Event Catalog of Alert Tracks (IceCube Collaboration, ApJS 269, 25, 2023), Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/SCRUCD, version 4, CC0
